component.name: MEGA Sync extension for Dolphin
component.summary: See and manage your MEGA files and syncs in Dolphin

description.p: Adds MEGA integration to Dolphin: check the sync status of your files and folders at a glance, and send, share or open them on MEGA without leaving the file manager.

ul.li: Easily see and track your sync statuses.
Send files and folders to MEGA.
Share your synced files and folders with anyone by creating links.
